The original Appzuku was left unmaintained in March 2026. This fork, Frenapps, keeps it free and open source under GPLv3 and focuses on stability: reproducible release builds, safer shell commands, boot auto-start that actually runs on Android 14+, and crash fixes. It also ships a full Latin-American Spanish translation and a step-by-step first-run intro. All credit for the original work goes to northmendo.
You can read the source or report an issue at any time from Settings.

Getting Started

Frenapps helps you save battery and reduce RAM usage by stopping background apps.

1. Permissions

You need either Root access or Shizuku. If you don\'t have Root, install Shizuku from the Play Store and follow its instructions.

2. Background Service

The Background Service toggle must be ON for any automation features to work. Once enabled, you can use any combination of the following:

3. Automation Options (Use Separately or Together)

Each of these features works independently. Enable only what you need:

Periodic Auto-Kill
Automatically kills apps on a timer (Check Frequency). Use this for continuous background cleanup.

Kill on Screen Lock
Kills apps when you lock your device. Great for cleaning up when you\'re done using your phone.

Smart RAM Threshold
Only kills apps if RAM usage exceeds your threshold (75%-100%). Applies to both Periodic Auto-Kill and Kill on Screen Lock. Prevents unnecessary kills when your device has plenty of free memory.

4. Example Configurations

Screen Lock Only: Enable Background Service + Kill on Screen Lock. Leave Periodic Auto-Kill OFF.

Timer Only: Enable Background Service + Periodic Auto-Kill. Set your preferred frequency.

Smart Kill: Enable Background Service + Kill on Screen Lock + Smart RAM Threshold. Apps only killed when RAM is high.

5. Manual Kill (No Service Needed)

These features work without the background service:

  • Main Screen: Select apps and tap the kill button
  • Quick Tile - Kill App: Tap to kill the current foreground app
  • Quick Tile - Kill Background Apps: Tap to run your configured whitelist/blacklist background kill
  • Widget: One-tap kill from your home screen

6. Kill Modes

Whitelist Mode (Default): Kills all apps EXCEPT those you whitelist.

Blacklist Mode: Kills ONLY the apps you select in the Blacklist.

7. Kill History

View statistics on which apps were killed and how often they relaunch. Apps that frequently restart (\'greedy apps\') can be added to Background Restriction so Android keeps them asleep as aggressively as possible.

⚠️ 8. System Apps Safety Warning

IMPORTANT: System apps are critical for device stability and functionality. Examples include:

  • Security apps (e.g., \'Security\' on Xiaomi/MIUI devices)
  • Android System UI (com.android.systemui)
  • Phone services and system frameworks

Risks of Blocking System Apps:
Blocking or killing system apps may cause crashes, boot loops, loss of functionality, broken widgets, delayed notifications, or device malfunction. Only modify system apps if you fully understand the consequences.

The app will warn you when selecting system apps in filters or Background Restriction.

Welcome

Frenapps closes apps that keep using RAM and battery in the background. These 6 steps make it work for you.

1. Grant permission (required)

Seeing and killing processes needs Root or Shizuku. Without permission the list stays empty and an orange notice appears on top.
• With Root: accept the Superuser prompt when the app opens.
• Without Root: install Shizuku, start its service (on Android 11+ you can use Pair device / wireless debugging from system Settings), then come back to Frenapps and tap Ask for permission.
Starting Shizuku from a computer with adb pair / adb connect also works.

2. Running apps list

The main screen shows the apps that are running and how much RAM they use. Tap an app to select it and press the red button to close it. Pull down to scan again. Tap an app's three-dot menu for more options (info, uninstall, hide).

3. Whitelist and blacklist

Whitelist (default mode): closes everything except the apps you add. This is the safe option: put WhatsApp, clock, music, banking, etc. here.
Blacklist: closes only the apps you choose. Change it in Settings → Mode.

4. Automation

In Settings turn on Background Service; without it nothing runs automatically. Then choose:
• Periodic Auto-Kill with the frequency you want.
• Kill on Screen Lock.
• Smart RAM Threshold: only closes apps when RAM goes above the percentage you set.

5. Kill without opening the app

The Quick Settings panel has two tiles: one closes the app you are using, the other runs your configured background kill. There is also a widget with a clean button and an app shortcut.

6. Be careful

Killing or restricting system apps can break notifications, the keyboard, or the whole phone. Frenapps warns you when you select one. If something stops working, reboot and remove that app from the blacklist.

You can read this again and the full help from Settings → Help.
